hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Count stable binary arrays with large zero and one values modulo 10^9 + 7 where run lengths are capped by limit.

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Represent counts ending in zero as dp0[i][j] and ending in one as dp1[i][j].

hints.title: Constant Time Transition
hints.text: Express the sum of valid states as total previous combinations minus the invalid state ending with limit identical consecutive elements.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: State transitions computed in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(limit) loop transitions yield cubic O(zero * one * limit) runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(zero * one) space for dynamic programming matrices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Achieve O(1) state transitions using prefix-sum subtraction.

solutions.approach: O(1) Transition Dynamic Programming with Prefix Subtraction
